$comment: Numbers a pregen's sheet prints that the class tables cannot derive.
The pool sheet is root truth. Where it disagrees with what Open5e's class
tables alone would give, the difference is a feat, a species trait, or a
class feature whose numbers the SRD publishes only as prose. Recording it
here makes it visible and reviewable; letting the tool absorb any mismatch
silently would also absorb a defect in our own data, which is exactly how
the 2024 fighter's saving throws stayed wrong.
Keyed by pool slug, which carries the level: a level 5 rogue's Alert bonus
is +3, not +2, because it is the proficiency bonus rather than a constant.
`why` is required and is the point of the file. Quote the sheet.
Keys inside `values`: `initiative`, or `skill.<name>` using the same names

dwarf-cleric-lv1.why: Divine Order — Thaumaturge (PHB-2024 70): 'You know one extra cantrip from the Cleric spell list. You also have a +2 bonus to your Arcana and Religion checks.' The bonus equals the Wisdom modifier, minimum +1; this cleric has Wisdom 15.

dwarf-cleric-lv2.why: Divine Order — Thaumaturge (PHB-2024 70): 'a bonus to your Intelligence (Arcana or Religion) checks. The bonus equals your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1)'. Wisdom is 16 from level 2, so the bonus is +3 rather than the +2 it is at level 1.

dwarf-cleric-lv3.why: Divine Order — Thaumaturge (PHB-2024 70): 'a bonus to your Intelligence (Arcana or Religion) checks. The bonus equals your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1)'. Wisdom is 16 from level 2, so the bonus is +3 rather than the +2 it is at level 1.

dwarf-cleric-lv4.why: Divine Order — Thaumaturge (PHB-2024 70): 'a bonus to your Intelligence (Arcana or Religion) checks. The bonus equals your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1)'. Wisdom is 16 from level 2, so the bonus is +3 rather than the +2 it is at level 1.

halfling-rogue-lv1.why: Alert (PHB-2024 200), from the Criminal background's origin feat: 'Initiative Proficiency. When you roll Initiative, add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll.' Proficiency is +2 at level 1.

halfling-rogue-lv2.why: Alert (PHB-2024 200), from the Criminal background's origin feat: 'Initiative Proficiency. When you roll Initiative, add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll.' Proficiency is +2 through level 4 and becomes +3 at level 5.
